name: standing abs rotation stretch
description: Rotates the upper body from a standing position to stretch the abs and obliques and loosen the trunk.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms relaxed.
Place your hands on your hips or hold them out to the sides.
Keep the hips facing forward and turn your upper body slowly to one side.
Look over your shoulder and breathe steadily.
Return to the front and rotate to the other side.
